title: Dimension-Free Scaling Laws for Size Generalization: An Exponential Separation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern machine learning models increasingly operate on variable-size structured data, such as sets and graphs. A central requirement is \emph{size generalization}: the ability of a model trained on inputs of one size to generalize to inputs of a different, potentially much larger, size. Classical statistical learning theory, however, primarily considers fixed input domains, and its guarantees often deteriorate with input dimension. Although extensive work has established when models on sets and graphs can be transferred across input sizes, such results do not characterize the statistical cost of doing so: the sample complexity of size generalization, and its relationship to classical in-domain learning, remain largely unknown. We develop a statistical learning theory of size generalization and establish a sharp exponential separation in sample complexity. translated_title: 面向尺寸泛化的无维度缩放定律：一种指数级分离
translated_abstract: 现代机器学习模型越来越多地处理可变大小的结构化数据，例如集合和图。一个核心需求是尺寸泛化：即模型在某一尺寸的输入上训练后，能够泛化到不同尺寸（可能大得多）输入的能力。然而，经典统计学习理论主要考虑固定的输入域，其理论保证往往随输入维度的增加而恶化。尽管已有大量工作确定了集合和图上的模型何时能够跨输入尺寸进行迁移，但这些结果并未刻画这样做的统计代价：尺寸泛化的样本复杂度，以及它与经典域内学习之间的关系，在很大程度上仍是未知的。我们发展了尺寸泛化的统计学习理论，并在样本复杂度上建立了一个尖锐的指数级分离。设 $n$ 表示训练样本的数量，我们证明了多项式源维度……
tldr: 该论文建立了尺寸泛化的统计学习理论，证明了尺寸泛化与经典域内学习之间存在样本复杂度上的指数级分离，并给出了与输入维度无关的缩放定律。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a statistical learning theory of size generalization and establishes a sharp exponential separation in sample complexity between size generalization and classical in-domain learning, accompanied by dimension-free scaling laws.
